CommunityApplications.Profile: Strata Supervisor: a web UI for Strata, the local LLM server for large mixture-of-experts models on consumer GPUs. Manage several model configs and load one at a time by hand. A private hobby project, not affiliated with the Strata project. The template is in unraid/. Support via GitHub issues: https://github.com/sognix/strata-supervisor/issues
